dims_rule: half-thickness L = the half_thickness default of the cut class (SD-051)
notes: [AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] A slice is thin against its width: the slab is the geometry and also the bound. Unchanged from Layer 2 0.4.0.

dims_rule: half-height Lz = L (SD-051), radius R = aspect x L
notes: [AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] Round slices of roots, tubers and fruit (coins, rounds). Aspect ratios are an agent convention, not sourced. Computed here (Bi 0.1-100, Fo 1e-3-1 on Lz): the centre theta differs from the slab by at most 0.16 / 0.0063 / 3e-8 at R / Lz = 2 / 4 / 8, the volume mean by 0.23 / 0.12 / 0.064 (the rim heats faster): the change is mostly an edge effect on the mean. Onion rings and pepper strips are not coins: the ingredient class cannot tell them apart.
[AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] Dice are cubes by definition of the cut; product of three slabs (exact for the cube, Heisler product).

[AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] Chopped pieces are irregular and roughly equant; a cube of the half-dimension is the slower of the equant shapes (a sphere of the same half-dimension heats faster), so it keeps the slow side.

[AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] Minced aromatics are small equant pieces. Minced (ground) meat formed into a patty or loaf is a different object (its size is the patty, not the mince): the cut class cannot see that.

[AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] Grated strands are long against their width; at length >= 10 x radius the infinite cylinder is within 1e-9 of the finite cylinder at the centre (SV04). Grated cheese melts and is not a conduction problem.
[AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] Shreds (cabbage, lettuce, cooked meat) are ribbons, thin against their width: slab. Unchanged.

dims_rule: no size default exists for HALVED
notes: [AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] The shape of a half depends on the item (hemisphere of a tomato, half a chicken). Layer 2 computes no core for HALVED (no size), so nothing changes.

dims_rule: no size default exists for CRUSHED
notes: [AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] Crushed items (garlic, tomatoes, biscuits) have no conduction geometry. No core is computed (no size).

dims_rule: radius R = an egg size (no registry row; no core is computed today)
notes: [AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] A whole egg is a prolate spheroid; the sphere of the minor semi-axis is the slower bound of it. Applies only when no cut class is bound and the lot is egg only. No size class, so Layer 2 has no core: diagnostic only.

dims_rule: radius R = a seed size (no registry row; no core is computed today)
notes: [AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] Whole beans, peas and chickpeas are near spheres; lentils are disks (finite cylinder) and split pulses are hemispheres: the class cannot tell them apart. Diagnostic only (no size).

dims_rule: half-thickness of the cut of meat (no registry row; no core is computed today)
notes: [AI_DRAFTED, PROPOSED] Steaks, chops, breasts and fillets are slab-like; roasts, whole birds and sausages are not (sphere / finite cylinder) and need the ingredient identity, not the food group. Unchanged.
